annotations.title: Check an Etsy listing (paused: Etsy's API unavailable)

description: PAUSED: Growtsy can't read Etsy's API right now (since 19 November 2026); this tool returns the error etsy_offline — don't retry it. Instead: ask the seller to paste the listing's title and tags and call etsy_listing_text_check. When Etsy access returns: Reads one Etsy listing from Etsy's API: title, the 13 tags, photo count and sizes, video, when it expires and whether it auto-renews, favorites, and whether the description mentions AI. Applies Etsy's published title/tag rules and returns the first thing to fix. Use for 'is my listing set up right?' and 'when does my listing expire?'.

url.description: Etsy listing link (etsy.com/listing/<number>) or the listing number
